description: This file contains functions for visualizing and plotting behavioral observation data, including behavior time budgets and event timelines, using Matplotlib. It interacts with a database of aggregated events, processes behavior annotations, and generates plots such as bar charts and Gantt-like diagrams for observational data, intended for a larger behavioral research software project (BORIS).

methods.name: default_value(ethogram, behavior, parameter)
methods.description: Returns a default value for behavior duration, especially for point events, using project configuration and behavior type.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif( ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif, include_modifiers, parameters, )
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary structure for behaviors and modifiers for selected subjects, behaviors, and parameters.

methods.name: dict init_behav(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behaviors, parameters)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary for subjects and their behaviors with default values for specified parameters.

methods.name: dict create_behaviors_bar_plot( pj: dict, selected_observations: list, param: dict, plot_directory: str, output_format: str, plot_colors: list = cfg.BEHAVIORS_PLOT_COLORS, )
methods.description: Generates bar plots summarizing behavior durations and occurrence counts over a specified time interval, saving or displaying the figures.

methods.name: create_events_plot( self, selected_observations, parameters, plot_colors=cfg.BEHAVIORS_PLOT_COLORS, plot_directory="", file_format="png", )
methods.description: Creates a Gantt-style timeline plot of behavior events for selected observations and subjects, supporting different time intervals and formats.
